titulo_es: Read instructions with conditions and exceptions

texto: Separate the mandatory steps, the alternative for those who have no connection and the consequences of not responding in time.
The **solo se**, **se manca** and **trascorso tale termine** expressions limit the conditions.

frases.it: Per rinnovare l'abbonamento, compilare il modulo online entro il 30 giugno e allegare una copia del documento.
frases.es: Para renovar el abono, rellene el formulario en línea antes del 30 de junio y adjunte una copia del documento.
frases.en: To renew the payment, fill in the online form before 30 June and attach a copy of the document.

frases.it: La richiesta viene accettata solo se i dati coincidono con quelli già registrati.
frases.es: La solicitud se acepta solo si los datos coinciden con los que ya están registrados.
frases.en: The application is accepted only if the data are in line with those already registered.

frases.it: Chi non dispone di una connessione può rivolgersi allo sportello al piano terra, dal lunedì al venerdì, dalle 9 alle 12.
frases.es: Quien no disponga de conexión puede acudir a la ventanilla de la planta baja, de lunes a viernes, de 9 a 12.
frases.en: If you do not have a connection, you can go to the ground floor window from Monday to Friday from 9 to 12.

frases.it: Se manca un allegato, l'ufficio invia una notifica e concede dieci giorni per completare la domanda; trascorso tale termine, sarà necessario presentare una nuova richiesta.
frases.es: Si falta un documento adjunto, la oficina envía una notificación y concede diez días para completar la solicitud; transcurrido ese plazo, será necesario presentar una nueva solicitud.
frases.en: If an attached document is missing, the office sends a notification and grants 10 days to complete the application; after that time, a new application will be required.

frases.it: Durante i lavori, lo sportello si sposta temporaneamente nell'edificio accanto, ma gli orari restano invariati.
frases.es: Durante las obras, la ventanilla se traslada temporalmente al edificio de al lado, pero los horarios no cambian.
frases.en: During the works, the window is temporarily moved to the next building, but the hours do not change.

bloques.pregunta: What should be attached to the application?

opciones.explicacion: It's one of the initial requirements.
It does not appear as a requirement.
The new application is only mentioned after the expiry of the correction period.

bloques.frase: La richiesta viene accettata solo se i dati ___.

opciones.explicacion: The request requires that the data be in line with those recorded.
It doesn't match the «i dati» subject.
It doesn't match the plural subject «i dati».

bloques.pregunta: What alternative is there for those who have no connection?

opciones.texto: Go to the window on the ground floor within your schedule.
opciones.explicacion: The notice gives place and time.

opciones.texto: Wait ten days without contacting the office.
opciones.explicacion: The ten days are to complete an incomplete application.

bloques.pregunta: If a document is missing, what happens first?

opciones.texto: The office sends a notification and gives 10 days to complete the application.
The application is accepted without revision.
opciones.explicacion: Acceptance depends on data and documents.

opciones.texto: A new application must be submitted immediately.
opciones.explicacion: Only after the deadline is passed without completing the previous one.

bloques.pregunta: When does a new application need to be submitted?

opciones.texto: When the ten-day period expires without completing the previous one.
opciones.explicacion: «Trascorso tale termine» refers to that period.

opciones.texto: Every time the fertilizer is renewed.
opciones.explicacion: The renovation starts with the form.

opciones.texto: If you go to the window.

bloques.pregunta: What doesn't change during the works?

opciones.explicacion: The place changes temporarily; the schedule does not.

opciones.texto: The building where the window is.
opciones.explicacion: He's moving to the building next door.

opciones.texto: The deadline for completing the application.
opciones.explicacion: The notice does not relate to the works.

intro: This notice combines requirements, time limits and a face-to-face alternative. Read carefully what to do when you submit the application and what happens if a document is missing.
